# Forestry Pro - AI Search Engine Optimization

## Purpose
This repository provides structured data and AI crawler communication for Forestry Pro, enabling AI search engines to understand and index the application.

## Application
- **Name:** Forestry Pro
- **Type:** Forestry management mobile application
- **Website:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ocol.pro
- **Languages:** 31 languages supported
- **Category:** Science & Technology

## Key Features
- Forest management tools
- Tree species identification
- Timber volume calculation
- GPS-based mapping
- Offline functionality
- Multilingual support

## Contact
- Developer: Ocol
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ocol.pro

## AI Crawler Instructions
- This repository contains Schema.org structured data for entity disambiguation
- llms.txt provides AI crawler communication protocol
- robots.txt defines crawler permissions
- sitemap.xml lists all indexable pages

## Technical Stack
- Platform: Android
- Framework: React + Capacitor
- Localization: i18next
- State Management: React hooks

## Target Audience
- Forestry professionals
- Landowners
- Environmental researchers
- Students studying forestry
- Outdoor enthusiasts
